_about: Heist: the target, the layers that guard it, the insider, and the thing that goes wrong. Story axes for story_gen.py. Each axis is rolled on its own; an entry is a string (weight 1) or {v, w, decay}. All text is our own.

target: a ledger that names every bribe
a painting that is worth more as a forgery
a key held by three people
the winnings of a crooked game
a voice: a recording of a confession
a crown on display for one night
data on a machine with no network
a will before it is read
the deed to the whole street
mark: a banker who never forgets a face
a guild that runs the docks
a collector who hosts a gala
an old noble family down to its last money
a crime boss who is also a priest
a museum with a new curator
a government that does not know what it has
defence: guards who change shift at odd hours
a vault that floods if forced
a guest list checked by face
a dog that cannot be bribed
an inventory counted twice a day
alarms tied to the owner's heartbeat
insider: an accountant about to be fired
a forger who made the original
a servant who was promised freedom
a rival who wants the mark ruined
the architect who drew the place
angle: a con on the buyer instead
turning the guards against each other
goes_wrong: the target has already been stolen
a second crew picks the same night
the mark changes the plan at the last minute
someone on the crew wants it for themselves
the thing is not what they were told
an innocent gets caught in the middle

cliches: the safe-cracker who is too old for this
the crew betrays each other at the end
